name: V28 q128 request_clear four-engine-seed preview
selection: First two unchanged E14 eligible manifest indices per length bin, no answer-based selection or truncation. Qualification selects longest of these six by token count.
stopping: Native DiffusionGemma generation config unchanged; per-request seeds unsupported. Engine seeds match across arms in a block but do not establish trajectory pairing.
timing: One warm-up per eligible item and engine; request boundary sync only; CPU scheduler phase counts; reject timed graph captures or backend/inductor compilations. W includes prefill, S begins at final prefill scheduler completion and includes canvas commits. N counts denoising forwards only. Future V28 runner also records vLLM monitor Triton/CuTe JIT event deltas; these are monitor events, not proof of all compiler/autotuner activity. OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 for every arm.
inference: Batch 1 single-engine offline native vLLM serving, HTTP/network excluded. Adapter arms PIECEWISE, dense official default graph mode. No per-step profiling events.
statistics: Six question clusters x four independent engine-seed blocks x two sequential repeat labels = 48 requests per arm. Preview only. Report paired geometric W,S,S/N,N, correctness; bootstrap questions, stratify length bins, display by-engine-seed results and N distribution. Same engine seed is not identical random trajectory; repeats are not extra independent seeds. A request-level conclusion requires expanded question coverage.
memory_preflight: Same 0.85 reservation for all arms, including dense. Request_clear is common adapter lifecycle engineering. Preserve allocation retry/oom counters and failed attempts.
scoring: Unchanged v15-lbv2-nemo-mcq-default-on-final-channel-1; decode token ids with special tokens preserved privately. Strict correctness requires EOS.
publication: No prompts, prompt hashes, raw outputs, answers or private binding paths. Frozen input/source hashes only in private binding. Public item indices are manifest ordinal labels.
gpu_accounting: Terminal receipt records whole worker reserved wall seconds, including loading, warmup and failures; per-request wall seconds reported separately.
supersedes_qualification_only: none: independent V28 follow-up; V18b unchanged
seed_update: User explicitly emphasized native stopping variability across seeds. This new protocol does not modify the running one-seed qualification002 or parent V18b.
